documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals reported a strong Q2 FY27 performance with revenue growing over 30% year-on-year and EBITDA more than doubling, driven by double-digit volume growth in the CDMO business. Management highlighted progress on key strategic initiatives including the European CDMO project, the Zambia government partnership, integration of Oriflame's manufacturing plants, and setting up a new facility in Baddi. The company maintains a healthy balance sheet with substantial cash reserves and positive operating cash flow. Management remains confident in long-term shareholder value creation through geographic expansion, capacity enhancement, and product mix optimization. Akums Drugs reported a strong Q2 FY27 with revenue growing over 30% and EBITDA more than doubling year-on-year, driven primarily by the CDMO segment's double-digit volume growth and improved API prices.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new Baddi facility to fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.
guidance.quote: The plant will have oral solids in Phase 1 with an annual capacity of over 6 billion units, which will fully operationalize by Q1 FY28.

guidance.claim: Commercial supplies for the European CDMO project are scheduled to commence in FY28.
guidance.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per our stated plans with supplies commencing in FY28.

guidance.claim: Commercial supplies from the Indian plant for the Zambia joint venture are scheduled during Q4 FY27.
guidance.quote: Our JV with the Zambia government is also progressing smoothly with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 and considering the prolonged shipping time to Zambia, we expect to book revenues during Q1 FY28.

guidance.claim: Management expects the domestic branded formulations segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28.
guidance.quote: We expect the segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28 as the current initiatives start bearing fruits.

guidance.claim: The company expects annual margins to remain in the 14% to 15% range.
guidance.quote: But overall, at an annual level, we expect that the margins should remain in the 14% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth to remain in double digits for the current and next year.
guidance.quote: So as of now, the expectation is we'll at least be double digits in our volume growth for this year, the next of the year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to recognize revenue from the Zambia order during the current financial year.
guidance.quote: And this fiscal, we'll recognize the revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.
demand_outlook.quote: While the availability and the prices of input materials remain volatile, the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.

demand_outlook.claim: CDMO business achieved volume growth of more than 20% on September net MAT basis.
demand_outlook.quote: Led by strong order book and improved utilization of newer facilities, the CDMO business achieved a volume growth of more than 20% on September net MAT basis showcasing increasing penetration of our offering within the India pharma market.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for CDMO remains robust.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for CDMO remains robust and Akums continues to deepen its presence within the IPM.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth was spearheaded by the CDMO segment with double digit volume growth.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was spearheaded by the CDMO segment with double digit volume growth and improvement in API prices.

demand_outlook.claim: The CDMO segment continues to see healthy demand and high-teen volume growth.
demand_outlook.quote: So the volumes also look healthy in high teens, at least for this quarter as well.

demand_outlook.claim: API prices are currently volatile but trending upwards.
demand_outlook.quote: API prices, they are volatile, right? But at this point in time, they are volatile, moving upwards.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully integrated 2 manufacturing plants acquired from Oriflame.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we successfully integrated the 2 manufacturing plants acquired from Oriflame.

capex_expansion.claim: Total H1 capex stands at INR 210 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So for this quarter, as I mentioned, there is an investment of INR210 crores. H1 total is INR210 crores that we made.

capex_expansion.claim: The European CDMO project is progressing as per plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per plan and we continue to make steady progress vis-à-vis our Zambia initiative with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 with revenue booking expected in Q1 FY 28.

capex_expansion.claim: A new facility in Baddi is being set up to boost oral manufacturing capabilities.
capex_expansion.quote: So we are in the process of setting up one more facility in Baddi, which will go live in the -- almost at the end of this financial year itself, which will significantly boost our oral manufacturing capabilities, right?

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter was reported at 14.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Margins were healthy at 14.5% as against 9.3% in Q2 FY26 and 15% in Q1 FY27.

margins_costs.claim: The API segment continued its journey towards becoming EBITDA breakeven.
margins_costs.quote: API segment continued on its journey towards becoming EBITDA breakeven as our endeavor continued.

margins_costs.claim: The trade generics segment remained EBITDA positive during the quarter for the third straight quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The trade generics segment remained EBITDA positive during the quarter with the third straight quarter of achieving profitability.

margins_costs.claim: Trade generics cemented EBITDA positivity during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The trade generic segment cemented EBITDA positivity during the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently operates at healthy utilization levels of above 50%.
orders_capacity.quote: We today operate at healthy utilization levels of above 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has 2 products approved in Europe, 8 filed, and over 30 in R&D.
orders_capacity.quote: We have 2 products approved in Europe, 8 filed and over 30 in R&D, which we expect to commercialize over next 3-4 years.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently operating at approximately 50% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: We have already -- we are already at 50-odd percent, right?

orders_capacity.claim: The company has agreed on volumes and prices for over 100 products to be supplied to Zambia.
orders_capacity.quote: As we speak, we are already in advanced stages where we have agreed upon the volumes and the prices with the government over there of almost 100-plus products that we would be supplying in Zambia.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents stand at INR 1,680 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain healthy and cash and cash equivalent as has been constantly increasing stands at INR1,680 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a cash surplus of INR1,616 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with a cash surplus of INR1,616 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately 98% of the company's cash is held in fixed deposits with nationalized banks.
capital_allocation.quote: Most of the money, in fact, 98% of the money is parked in fixed deposits with nationalized banks, right?

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the availability and prices of input materials remain volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the availability and the prices of input materials remain volatile, the demand outlook for CDMO remains strong.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that API prices are volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: API prices, they are volatile, right?

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic branded formulation margins were impacted by an increase in employee strength.
risks_headwinds.quote: Margins were impacted due to an increase in employee strength.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commercialize over 30 products currently in R&D over the next 3-4 years.
management_commitments.quote: We have 2 products approved in Europe, 8 filed and over 30 in R&D, which we expect to commercialize over next 3-4 years.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies for the European CDMO project will commence in FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per our stated plans with supplies commencing in FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies from the Indian plant for Zambia are scheduled during Q4 FY27, with revenue expected to be booked during Q1 FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Our JV with the Zambia government is also progressing smoothly with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 and considering the prolonged shipping time to Zambia, we expect to book revenues during Q1 FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The plant in Zambia is expected to become operational in 2029.
management_commitments.quote: The plant is expected to become operational in 2029, expanding our manufacturing presence outside India.

management_commitments.claim: The domestic branded formulations segment is expected to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the segment to deliver growth on par with IPM by FY28 as the current initiatives start bearing fruits.

management_commitments.claim: Management endeavors to achieve EBITDA breakeven in the API segment over the next 3, 4 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: So no time lines as of now. I think consistently around you've seen the numbers, roughly INR5 crores plus/minus INR1 crores is roughly what we bleed as on today. But the endeavour is that over the next 3, 4 quarters, we should be breakeven in this segment.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies from the Indian plant for the Zambia initiative are scheduled during Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our European CDMO project is progressing as per plan and we continue to make steady progress vis-à-vis our Zambia initiative with commercial supplies from the Indian plant scheduled during Q4 FY27 with revenue booking expected in Q1 FY 28.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve monthly EBITDA positivity in the API segment.
management_commitments.quote: So the whole target is on a monthly level, at least by the end of February, March, we should be monthly EBITDA positive in this business.

management_commitments.claim: The new Baddi facility is expected to go live.
management_commitments.quote: So we are in the process of setting up one more facility in Baddi, which will go live in the -- almost at the end of this financial year itself

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to deliver the Zambia order.
management_commitments.quote: Zambia is something we expect in the H2 that we deliver for this fiscal

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
